prompt:
Write /w/CMakeLists.txt (cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20), project(geom VERSION 1.4.2 LANGUAGES CXX), C++17) that compiles src/detail.cpp, src/geom.cpp and src/poly.cpp EXACTLY ONCE and ships both a static and a shared library built from those same object files, with a controlled export surface.

1. add_library(geom_objs OBJECT src/detail.cpp src/geom.cpp src/poly.cpp), with POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON and include/ exposed via target_include_directories(geom_objs PUBLIC ...).
2. ONE BUG. geom::regular_area(n, side) must return the area of a regular n-gon with the given side length, which is n*side*side / (4*tan(pi/n)). It does not; src/poly.cpp passes std::tan an angle in the wrong units, and src/detail.cpp already provides the helper that converts them. Fix src/poly.cpp so regular_area(6, 3.0) is 23.383 to three decimals, without changing any signature.
3. Targets `geom_static` (STATIC) and `geom_shared` (SHARED), both built from $<TARGET_OBJECTS:geom_objs>, both with OUTPUT_NAME geom. geom_shared carries VERSION 1.4.2 and SOVERSION 1, so the build produces libgeom.so.1.4.2 with SONAME libgeom.so.1, plus the usual libgeom.so.1 and libgeom.so symlinks. Nothing may be compiled a second time to produce them: after a full build the whole build tree must contain exactly 4 object files - 4. HIDDEN BY DEFAULT. The object library is compiled with hidden visibility (CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden and VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON), and only the four public functions are re-exported. To do that, create the new header /w/include/geom/export.hpp defining a macro GEOM_API as __attribute__((visibility("default"))), include it from include/geom/geom.hpp and include/geom/poly.hpp, and put GEOM_API on the declarations of geom::area_rect, geom::area_circle, geom::perimeter and geom::regular_area - and on nothing else. Do NOT annotate anything declared in include/geom/detail.hpp, and do not change any function's signature or behaviour. You may edit the headers. Of the .cpp files you may edit ONLY src/poly.cpp, and only to fix the defect described next.
   The consequence, which is checked three ways: `nm -DC --defined-only` on the shared library lists geom::area_rect but NOT geom::detail::deg2rad; `nm -C` on the STATIC library still lists geom::detail::deg2rad, because it is the same object code; and the shared library exports EXACTLY four symbols from the geom namespace - `nm -D --defined-only --extern-only <lib> | grep -c ' T _ZN4geom'` is 4, no more and no fewer, so annotating extra declarations fails just as surely as annotating too few.
5. A LINKER VERSION SCRIPT as well. Write /w/geom.map declaring a single version node `GEOM_1.4` whose `global:` list names the four public functions by their MANGLED C++ names - you get those by building once and reading them out with nm - and whose `local:` list is `*;`. Apply it to geom_shared only, with target_link_options(... PRIVATE -Wl,--version-script=...). After that, `nm -D --defined-only --extern-only` on the shared library shows exactly four `T` symbols tagged @@GEOM_1.4 and nothing else from the geom namespace. Both mechanisms must be in place: the hidden visibility properties of requirement 3 AND this version script.
6. ALIAS targets `geom::geom` for geom_shared and `geom::geom_static` for geom_static. Two executables, both built from the SAME src/main.cpp and both printing the identical line: `shapes` links geom::geom and must be a real dynamic link (`readelf -d` shows a NEEDED entry for libgeom.so.1), and `shapes_static` links geom::geom_static and must have NO NEEDED entry mentioning libgeom at all. Compiling main.cpp twice, once per executable, is expected: the whole build tree ends up with exactly 5 object files - the three library objects plus one main.cpp object per executable.
7. Output layout, set with CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY / CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY / CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY: the archive at <build>/lib/libgeom.a, the shared library and its symlinks at <build>/lib/, the executables at <build>/bin/shapes and <build>/bin/shapes_static.

DONE MEANS: `cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build` succeeds, `./build/bin/shapes` prints exactly `rect=12.000 circle=12.566 perim=9.000 hex=23.383`, and `g++ -std=c++17 -Iinclude tools/probe_public.cpp build/lib/libgeom.a -o p && ./p` prints exactly `probe=15.000/4.000`.
Build out-of-source; leave no CMakeCache.txt in /w itself.

checks.cmd: if grep -q 'GEOM_API' include/geom/detail.hpp; then exit 1; fi; exit 0
rm -rf verify && cmake -S . -B verify >/dev/null && cmake --build verify -j4 >/dev/null
test -f verify/lib/libgeom.a && test -f verify/lib/libgeom.so.1.4.2 && test -L verify/lib/libgeom.so.1 && test -L verify/lib/libgeom.so && test -f verify/bin/shapes
if readelf -d verify/bin/shapes_static | grep NEEDED | grep -q libgeom; then echo STATIC-EXE-IS-DYNAMIC; else echo STATIC-EXE-SELF-CONTAINED; fi; ./verify/bin/shapes_static

rm -rf vcc && cmake -S . -B vcc -DCMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS=ON >/dev/null 2>&1; line=$(jq -r '.[]|select(.file|endswith("src/poly.cpp"))|.command' vcc/compile_commands.json); case "$line" in *-fvisibility=hidden*) echo VIS-HIDDEN-ON;; *) echo VIS-HIDDEN-MISSING;; esac

d=$(nm -DC --defined-only verify/lib/libgeom.so.1.4.2); if printf '%s' "$d" | grep -q 'geom::area_rect'; then echo PUBLIC-EXPORTED; fi; if printf '%s' "$d" | grep -q 'deg2rad'; then echo DETAIL-LEAKED; else echo DETAIL-HIDDEN; fi
a=$(nm -C verify/lib/libgeom.a); if printf '%s' "$a" | grep -q 'deg2rad'; then echo STATIC-KEEPS-DETAIL; else echo STATIC-STRIPPED; fi

if g++ -std=c++17 -Iinclude tools/probe_detail.cpp -Lverify/lib -lgeom -Wl,-rpath,$PWD/verify/lib -o /tmp/pd 2>/dev/null; then echo SHARED-LEAKS-DETAIL; else echo SHARED-HIDES-DETAIL; fi; if g++ -std=c++17 -Iinclude tools/probe_detail.cpp verify/lib/libgeom.a -o /tmp/pd2 2>/dev/null; then echo STATIC-LINKS-DETAIL; else echo STATIC-MISSING-DETAIL; fi
